question: What was the commission revenue only for branch IEMJHuQgCPDHCwwJkgQQeaqGvzMcVD in 2013?
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(fact_trades.Commission) AS commission_revenue FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades AS fact_trades INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date AS dim_date ON fact_trades.SK_CreateDateID = dim_date.SK_DateID INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_broker AS dim_broker ON fact_trades.SK_BrokerID = dim_broker.SK_BrokerID WHERE dim_date.CalendarYearID = 2013 AND dim_broker.Branch = 'IEMJHuQgCPDHCwwJkgQQeaqGvzMcVD' LIMIT 100
